note: JSON files whose strings a person reads. Every string value that reads as prose (two words or more, letters) becomes one message dat-<sha12 of the English string> in i18n/en/data.ftl, except values under the skipped keys. Object keys, identifiers, commands, urls and numbers are never messages. tools/i18n.mjs data writes the catalogue; apply writes <lang>/<file> with the translated strings; the pages load <lang>/<file> when it exists (lib/t.mjs fetchData). A file marked module is `export default <JSON>;`, handled the same way.
